text:
You are like the high and slender light.

Like the wind you are clear without knowing it.

Your bearing wavers like the afternoon

softly leaning over the world.


You are made of forgotten dreams

and I forget you suddenly, as one forgets a dream;

my heart seeks you as smoke

seeks the height and dies toward it.


Like a warm flower the day carries you

fastened between its lips. You are tall,

blue, slender, and straight as a whistle.

I remember you suddenly as one remembers a dream.

translation.title: You Are Like the High and Slender Light...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the beloved as light, wind, smoke, flower, and remembered dream.
